title: We have *JUST* 7 days left.
speaker: Kevin Paffrath

macro_themes.view: ~$140B of AI/SpaceX/Oracle capital raises in a week are sucking money from stocks into higher-yield bonds, hurting chips but oddly helping Apple.
Public hawkishness masks near-complete negotiations; best window for a US-Iran deal is Oct 20-27, before the Fed meeting, which could make the Fed one-and-done on hikes.
The 10-year peaked around 5.27% and is rolling over with a bullish flattening, signalling peak oil/CPI and a coming Iran deal.
Tomorrow's CPI expectations are set up badly, so the stretch until Oct 20 could be a headache.
More Gulf pipelines, lower oil, and AI deflation could converge into lower rates, good for real estate and stocks.

calls.condition: Bullish if an Iran deal lands Oct 20-27; if no Iran deal 'we've got massive problems' as the 10-year would rise more
calls.reason: Strong ADP data keeps him higher on the 'bearable bull' scale; CPI is a near-term risk but an Iran deal and falling long yields would be bullish.
calls.quote: let's get through CPI and we should be good. Uh but uh I'm optimistic. I set a threshold for... buying the dip

calls.condition: Assumes an Iran deal; without one the 10-year 'is going to have to potentially rise even more'
calls.reason: Yield slope flattened and rotated down from his 5.27% peak call; 2s10s spread narrowing to 41bp signals peak inflation expectations.
calls.quote: The 10-year is at 521. This is actually below my peak of 527.

calls.reason: Money rotates into Apple whenever capital-raise ('suckening') announcements drain chip stocks; bounced from 332 as he called.
calls.quote: Apple loves it when everyone else gets sucked dry of capital.

calls.reason: Called a bounce off the 717 close two days running; new frontier AI model and aggressive Muse free Max-plan promotion.
calls.quote: Really smart by Zuck. I'm pretty bullish meta.

calls.condition: Assuming some reasonable level of growth continues
calls.reason: Sold off on CEO 'casino' comments he thinks were misunderstood; ~0.6 PEG makes it dirt cheap and it could be a 4-5x from here.
calls.quote: this is a dirt cheap stock. It should probably be a four or fivex from where it is now.

calls.condition: Depends on an Iran deal and new Gulf pipeline capacity
calls.reason: Oil is close to peak; diversified pipeline export routes and a deal should bring prices down substantially over time.
calls.quote: probably in the long term brings oil prices down even more... you end up with you know oil prices coming down substantially

notes: Host says 'today's the 13th', CPI tomorrow. AAPL price_at_call 346 inferred from 'bounced off 332... up 14 points'. Broadcom 'a6 peg' transcribed; read as ~0.6 PEG. Also plans a Kalshi bet on exactly one Fed hike (one-and-done), not recorded as a market call.
